cuisines.name: Indian / Pakistani
tips: Tandoori and tikka (dry, from the clay oven) are the lean picks; anything "masala", "makhani", "korma" or "malai" is cream and butter (+300–500 kcal).
Skip the naan or split it: one plain naan is about 260 kcal, garlic/butter naan more.
Ask for half rice; entrees usually come with ~1.5 cups (300 kcal).
Dal tadka is the leanest veg protein; dal makhni has butter and cream.
cuisines.halal: Many Indian/Pakistani places are halal but not all; check the place. Biryani and curries are fine to ask about.

orders.name: Chicken tikka (dry) + half rice
orders.how: Ask for no butter brushed on top, half rice, raita on the side.

orders.name: Tandoori shrimp or fish + salad
orders.how: Swap rice for salad if they will, lemon instead of dressing.

orders.name: Tandoori chicken (skin off) + salad
orders.how: Pull the skin, no butter on top.

orders.name: Dal tadka + half rice + raita
orders.how: Yellow dal, not dal makhni.

orders.name: Chana masala + half rice
orders.how: Ask for less oil.

cuisines.name: Mediterranean / Middle Eastern
tips: Plate over sandwich: you control the sides. Ask for salad instead of rice, or half and half.
Get garlic sauce (toum) and tahini on the side: toum is about 100 kcal per tablespoon.
Skip the pita that comes with dips (about 165 kcal each) or eat half.
Falafel is fried; good for veg but low protein per calorie.
cuisines.halal: Lots of shawarma/kebab spots are halal; gyro meat at Greek diners usually isn't. Check the place.

orders.name: Chicken kebab plate, greens + half rice
orders.how: Sauce on the side, hummus scoop, no pita.

orders.name: Shrimp or salmon kebab, greens + half rice
orders.how: Lemon and herbs, sauce on side.

orders.name: Lentil soup + 3 falafel + salad
orders.how: Dressing on the side.

orders.name: Half roasted chicken, skin off, salad side
orders.how: Skip the rice and pita.

cuisines.name: Halal cart / platter
tips: A regular platter with full white sauce is 900–1,000+ kcal. Small platter + extra lettuce is the move.
White sauce is about 300 kcal per serving: use half, or swap for hot sauce (7 kcal).
cuisines.halal: Halal carts usually are halal (it's the name), but the slaughter method varies; ask who supplies the chicken.

orders.name: Small chicken platter, half white sauce
orders.how: Extra lettuce, half the white sauce, hot sauce to taste.
orders.basis: The Halal Guys published nutrition (small chicken platter 471 kcal) + half a white sauce

orders.name: Regular chicken platter, no white sauce
orders.how: Hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon instead.

orders.name: Falafel platter, small, half white sauce
orders.how: Mostly carbs and fat; split it if you can.

cuisines.name: Mexican / burrito bowls
tips: Bowl, not burrito: a burrito tortilla is about 320 kcal.
Fajita veggies and salsa are almost free; chips (540), queso and sour cream are not.
Half rice + beans keeps it filling.
Refried and pinto beans can be made with lard (pork) at small places; ask, or get black beans.
cuisines.halal: Chain meats (Chipotle, Qdoba, Moe's) aren't halal. Veg and fish orders below work anywhere.

orders.name: Veggie bowl + sofritas
orders.how: Lettuce, half rice, black beans, sofritas, fajita veg, salsa, light cheese.

orders.name: Grilled shrimp or fish tacos (3, corn)
orders.how: Grilled not fried, no crema, extra cabbage and salsa.

orders.name: Chicken bowl, no rice
orders.how: Chicken, black beans, fajita veg, salsa, lettuce. Only at a halal place.

cuisines.name: Sushi / Japanese
tips: Sashimi and naruto rolls (cucumber wrap, no rice) are the highest protein per calorie.
Anything tempura, "crunch" or with spicy mayo adds 100–200 kcal a roll.
Eel sauce, teriyaki and many glazes are made with mirin or sake (alcohol). Ask for ponzu or plain soy, and check imitation crab labels for mirin.
cuisines.halal: Fish orders work anywhere. Ask about mirin/sake in sauces and seasoned rice vinegar.

orders.name: Sashimi, 10 pieces (tuna + salmon)
orders.how: Add a seaweed salad or miso soup if you have room.

orders.name: Naruto roll (no rice)
orders.how: Cucumber-wrapped tuna/salmon/avocado.

orders.name: Tuna roll (6 pieces)
orders.how: Plain, not spicy.

orders.name: Poke bowl, half rice half greens
orders.how: Tuna, cucumber, edamame, ponzu; skip spicy mayo and crunch.

cuisines.name: Chinese
tips: Steamed with sauce on the side is the cheat code. Anything crispy, General Tso's or orange is about 1,000 kcal an order; lo mein is ~900.
Many sauces use Shaoxing cooking wine. Ask for no cooking wine, or steamed with sauce on the side.
cuisines.halal: Chicken and beef usually aren't halal unless the place says so. Shrimp and tofu orders below work anywhere.

orders.name: Steamed shrimp & broccoli + half rice
orders.how: Brown or garlic sauce on the side, use a little.

orders.name: Steamed tofu & mixed veg + half rice
orders.how: Sauce on the side.

orders.name: Hot & sour or egg drop soup
orders.how: Good starter that fills you up for ~100 kcal.

cuisines.name: Thai
tips: Pad thai is ~900–1,000 kcal; green/red/massaman curries with coconut milk are 600–800 a serving.
Clear soups (tom yum) and basil stir-fries with half rice are the lean picks. Fish sauce is fine (it's fish).
cuisines.halal: Shrimp, fish and tofu work anywhere; chicken only at a halal place.

orders.name: Tom yum soup with shrimp
orders.how: Clear version, not coconut (tom kha).

orders.name: Basil shrimp or tofu, less oil, half rice
orders.how: Ask for light oil.

orders.name: Fresh summer rolls (2) with shrimp
orders.how: Peanut sauce on the side, use half.

cuisines.name: Pizza / Italian
tips: Thin crust, veggie toppings, 2 slices + side salad.
Vodka sauce, marsala and piccata use alcohol; pepperoni and sausage are usually pork.
Pasta portions are often 3+ cups; ask for a half or lunch portion.
cuisines.halal: Halal pizza places exist (halal pepperoni/chicken); otherwise stick to veg or shrimp.

orders.name: Thin crust veggie, 2 slices + side salad
orders.how: Light cheese if they offer it, dressing on side.

orders.name: Shrimp marinara, half portion
orders.how: Marinara, not vodka or scampi butter.

orders.name: Minestrone + side salad
orders.how: Light, filling starter or lunch.

cuisines.name: Burgers / American
tips: Lettuce wrap or open-face cuts ~200 kcal of bun.
Swap fries (~400 kcal medium) for a side salad or fruit.
Bacon is pork; "turkey" bacon/sausage isn't halal unless the place is.
cuisines.halal: Halal burger joints are common in college towns; otherwise grilled fish or veggie burgers.

orders.name: Single burger, lettuce wrap, no mayo
orders.how: One slice of cheese, mustard + veggies. Only at a halal place.

orders.name: Grilled fish sandwich, no tartar
orders.how: Grilled, not fried.

orders.name: Black bean burger, lettuce wrap + side salad
orders.how: Dressing on the side.

cuisines.name: Breakfast / diner
tips: Egg white veggie omelet + dry wheat toast + fruit is the classic.
Bacon, sausage, ham are pork; hash browns ~300 kcal.
Pancakes: one short stack is ~500 kcal before butter and syrup.
cuisines.halal: Eggs and veg work anywhere; meats only at a halal place.

orders.name: Egg white veggie omelet, dry toast, fruit
orders.how: No cheese, cooked with spray not butter if they will.

orders.name: Greek yogurt parfait + 2 eggs
orders.how: Granola on the side.
